obligations.action_summary: Make no assessment of additional tax more than three years after a return is filed, except for willfully false or fraudulent returns or when no return was filed.
obligations.quote: no assessment of additional tax shall be made after the expiration of more than three years from the date of the filing of a return
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof

obligations.actor_raw: the treasury of the town of Cornwall
obligations.action_summary: Pay all hotel and motel tax revenues into the town treasury and credit them to the town's general fund.
obligations.quote: All revenues resulting from the imposition of the tax under the local laws shall be paid into the treasury of the town of Cornwall and shall be credited to and deposited in the general fund of the town.
obligations.law_title: Authorizes the town of Cornwall in Orange county to impose a hotel and motel tax; and provides for the repeal of such provisions upon expiration thereof

obligations.action_summary: Establish an enforcement officer to oversee investigations of complaints of violations of the mandatory overtime limits.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

obligations.action_summary: Investigate complaints of mandatory overtime violations, in consultation with the department of health, and notify the employer.

obligations.law_title: Relates to the restrictions on consecutive hours of work for nurses

obligations.action_summary: Develop and post on its website a poster telling employees how to file a complaint.
